verses.1: And when the house was built, and the doors were set in place, then the windows and doors were also installed.
verses.2: And I will urge my brother Hanani, and Hanania, the chief priest in Jerusalem, to do so. For he is a true man who fears God greatly.
verses.3: And he said to them, “Do not open the doors of Jerusalem until the sun rises. The doors must remain locked, and no one may stand in their presence. Each person must keep watch over his own house.”
verses.4: And the city was wide and large in size. The people lived in it in small groups; there were no built-up houses there at all.
verses.5: And God gave me the ability to see things clearly. I could see the secrets and mysteries of the people. I found out what those who are hidden from others really are like. I also learned what was written in those things.
verses.6: These are the sons of the land that came back from the exile. They were brought back by Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem and Judea, with each person going to their own city.
verses.7: Those who come with Zerubbabel will be saved. May Nekhemia, Azarya, and Ra’amya bless them. May Mordechai also be blessed. May the people of Israel be comforted.
verses.8: The sons of Pharaohsh were one hundred and seventy-two.
verses.9: The sons of Shephatia were three hundred and twenty-two.
verses.10: The sons of Arach were seventy-two.
verses.11: The sons of Pachat Movav are Yishua and Yoav Alfyim. And Semona from the tribe of Oth Semona is eleven in number.
verses.12: The sons of Eilam were eight thousand and forty-four.
verses.13: The sons of Zathua were forty-five in number.
verses.14: The sons of Zakhai were seventy and sixty.
verses.15: The sons of Benuy were six hundred and thirty.
verses.16: The sons of Bevi were six hundred and thirty.
verses.17: The sons of Azgad were three hundred and twenty-two.
verses.18: The sons of Adonikam were sixty-seven in number.
verses.19: The sons of Bagoi were six hundred and seventy-seven.
verses.20: The sons of Adin were sixty and fifty-three.
verses.21: The sons of Atar for Hizkiah were ninety and seventy.
verses.22: The sons of Chashum were three hundred and seventy.
verses.23: The sons of Betzai were three hundred and forty-four.
verses.24: The sons of Harif were one hundred and ten in number.
verses.25: The sons of Gibeon were ninety-five in number.
verses.26: The people of Bet-Lehem and Netophah, a hundred men and women.
verses.27: There were a hundred and thirty people who asked questions.
verses.28: The people of Bet-Azmaveth were forty-two in number.
verses.29: The people of Kiriat Yerim are like trees that grow in the forest. They number seventy and three.
verses.30: The people of Ramah and Gaba were six hundred and one.
verses.31: There were a hundred and twenty-two people from Mikmas.
verses.32: The people of Bethel were one hundred and thirty-three in number.
verses.33: The people of Nebo were fifty-two in number.
verses.34: The sons of Eilam were eight thousand, four hundred and thirty.
verses.35: The sons of Harim were three thousand and one hundred.
verses.36: The sons of Jerah were three hundred and forty-five.
verses.37: The sons of Lod were Hadid and Ono, who numbered seventy-one.
verses.38: The sons of Senaah were three thousand, ninety-six hundred and thirty.
verses.39: The priests, sons of Jedaya, were in the house of Jesus. There were fifty-seven of them.
verses.40: The sons of Immer were eight hundred and fifty-two.
verses.41: The sons of Pashhur were eight hundred and forty-seven.
verses.42: The sons of Harim were one thousand seventy.
verses.43: May the children of Jesus be honored before the children of Lodovah, seventy-four in total.
verses.44: The rulers are the sons of Asaf: one hundred forty-five.
verses.45: The sons of Shalum, the sons of Atar, the sons of Talmon, the sons of Akub, the sons of Hattita, and the sons of Shobai. A hundred thirty and seventy in total.
verses.46: The descendants of Tziha, the descendants of Chashupa, the descendants of Tabaloth.
verses.47: Bnei Keros, Bnei Sia, Bnei Padoon.
verses.48: Children of Levanah, children of Hagavah, children of Shalmai.
verses.49: Bnei Hanan, Bnei Gidel, Bnei Gachar.
verses.52: The sons of Besai, the sons of Meunim, the sons of Nefisims.
verses.53: Bnei Bakbuk, Bnei Chakufa, Bnei Harhur.
verses.54: Bnei Batzilit, Bnei Mechida, Bnei Harsha.
verses.55: Bnei Barcos, Bnei Sisra, Bnei Tamach.
verses.56: The sons of Nitzach are the sons of Hattipa.
verses.57: The sons of Solomon’s servants, the sons of Sotai, the sons of Soferet, and the sons of Prida.
verses.58: Bnei Ya’ela, Bnei Drakon, Bnei Gidel.
verses.59: The sons of Shephtiyah, the sons of Chatil, the sons of Pocherhet, the sons of Tzbayim, and the sons of Amon.
verses.60: All the singers and sons of Solomon’s servants were seventy-two in number.
verses.61: And these people come from salt marshes, like barren fields. They cannot tell the names of their ancestors or their descendants, if they are indeed from Israel.
verses.62: Bnei Delaya, Bnei Toviya, Bnei Nekoda – six hundred and forty-two in total.
verses.63: And from the priests, there were sons of Hava; from the sons of Kots, there were sons of Barzilai. He took a woman from among the daughters of Barzilai’s family, and he named her after him.
verses.64: They sought their written records, but they could not be found. So they were disappointed by the priest.
verses.65: And the priest said to them, “Do not eat anything that is consecrated during the day until the priest comes and examines them.”
verses.66: All the people together make four hundred thousand, three hundred and sixty.
verses.67: In addition to their servants and women, there are also seven thousand three hundred and seventy-two men and women. They have thousands of rulers and administrators. There are also forty-five people in total.
verses.68: Four hundred, thirty-five hundred, and six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
verses.69: And from the heads of those fathers, they were given for the work of weaving. Ozer received gold threads, a thousand strings in total. There were also thirty-five coats of paint.
verses.70: And from the heads of those fathers, they gave to the workers of this craft gold in large quantities, along with silver in thousands and hundreds of pieces.
verses.71: And the rest of the people were given gold jewelry, two rulers, and thousands of pieces of silver. They also received sixty-seven sets of sacred symbols as gifts.
verses.72: And the priests, the Levites, the singers, the gatekeepers, and all the people, along with those who were responsible for distributing food, gathered together from their cities. The seventh day of the month arrived, and the Israelites in their cities also gathered together.
